correctness.rationale: On exchangeable pairs with endpoint masses (a,c), TV to (A,C) is one half the sum of |A−a|, |C−c|, and |A+C−a−c|. Negative covariance is equivalent to √a+√c<1: both endpoint deviations from the product at the original mean equal the covariance. A de Finetti competitor satisfies √A+√C≥1 by the L² triangle inequality. If A<a, the product at √a strictly improves on the competitor's error on cell 00; the reverse case is symmetric. In the remaining quadrant the endpoint sum is the objective. A point with √A+√C>1 dominates a product law at any parameter in [√a,1−√c]∩[1−√C,√A], which is nonempty and lowers at least one endpoint strictly. This reduces the problem to a strictly convex quadratic, giving the clamped half and uniqueness. Equality in the L² bound forces a constant directing variable (including degenerate endpoints). For nonnegative covariance, mixing the deterministic parameter at the original mean with the {0,1} distribution of the same mean realizes the needed variance; means 0 and 1 are immediate. Finite exchangeability is the convex hull of the fixed-count urn laws, so convexity of distance reduces the maximum to them. With z=(N−m)/N≥1/2, the endpoint branch 2z−2√[z(Nz−1)/(N−1)] decreases in z, since (2Nz−1)²−4(N−1)z(Nz−1)=4z(Nz−1)+1>0; the central branch grows with m through N/2 and joins continuously. Thus the balanced integers are extremal. Substitution yields the claimed parity formulas; N=2,3,4 give 1/2, 4/3−√(4/3), and 1/6 respectively, in half-L¹ TV.
residual_risks: No assertion of uniqueness of every finite-extension extremizer is made. The parameter of the approximating law need not preserve the original marginal. No formal verification is claimed.

General finite de Finetti and fixed-population comparisons
value.rationale: The projection answers how much any negatively dependent binary pair must change to become infinitely extendible, not merely how well a prescribed sampler approximates it. It shows exactly when moving the one-bit marginal improves the fit and identifies a unique product even among all product mixtures. The first nontrivial odd urn already distinguishes the optimized and empirical parameters; the parity formulas give the sharp finite-extension benchmark. The value is the projection geometry and sharp optimization, not the size of the small asymptotic improvement alone.
residual_risks: No extension to larger alphabets, higher marginals, or other discrepancy metrics is established.
